rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7472.80 (2026-07-02 cash close). ATR14 = 92.86 (14 cash sessions to 2026-07-02). SUPPRESSION TEST: the pivot-tier trigger is tested first. The report suppressed Trade 2 because its own prior-day H/L were single-source indicative. On the regeneration basis the prior-day H/L/C are the slice's own D-1 cash session (H 7541.00 / L 7427.00 / C 7472.80), so the daily tier is computable and reproducible rather than indicative - and the rule requires pivots that can be computed from corroborated prior-period H/L/C to be computed before the test is run.
